blocks.text: Thanks for this. To keep the audit moving, I have three of the internal interviews penciled in for next week and am waiting on two more to confirm. Once those last two land, I will send you the full schedule in a single note, so you can see the whole set at once rather than in pieces.

Kimberly Le will fold her coverage read into the same interviews, so we ask each person about the themes the press has raised rather than running the two tracks apart. That keeps the conversations short and pointed, which I know matters for the people you are lending us.

The one open item is still the investor materials Kimberly asked about. If those reach us before the interviews begin, we go into each conversation already knowing what {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} has said publicly, which spares your people fielding the same questions twice. I will keep these requests coming to you directly, Robert Smith, rather than across the Gallegos, Pope and Marsh team. Send them when you can and we will build the rest around them.
